anati.gob.pa and registro-publico.gob.pa returned 403s/connection errors in every with-skill run that tried them. The skill's designed response (disclose the failure inline, cite named aggregator/law-firm sources instead of a live .gob.pa URL, never silently launder the gap) is working as intended, but this is a real, recurring environment limitation worth knowing about rather than a one-off fluke.

With-skill runs take roughly 2x longer than baseline (mean 566s vs. 275s) and use more tokens on 2 of 3 evals — the cost of the four-phase research workflow (SERP teardown, UGC mining, per-figure sourcing). Given the accuracy gap on the guide page, this reads as a reasonable trade for legal/financial content; worth watching whether it's still worth it on simpler/thinner page types.

Two with-skill runs (Boquete area page, titled-vs-ROP guide) reported that Reddit was unreachable to WebSearch/WebFetch in this environment, so UGC mining fell back to expat-forum blogs and comment threads.
